name: Done
use: Use after a save that closes a sheet and lands where the result is not visible: Record treatment returning to the walk list.
notUse: Not when the result shows where you land (the row itself says it), not for each entry inside a task, not for an upload that succeeds later, never for a failure.

name: Offline
use: Use for the same save made with no connection: it is kept on this phone and uploads when connected.
notUse: Not as the only offline signal: the header badge carries the state after the toast has gone.
